'''Alternate World Goh''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|平行世界|へいこうせかい}}のゴウ''' ''Alternate World Go'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN090|Showdown at the Gates of Warp!]]''. He is [[Goh]]'s counterpart from the {{pkmn|multiverse#In animation|Alternate World}}.

Alternate Goh first appeared in [[Canalave City]], from where he and [[Alternate World Chloe]] picked up [[Alternate World Ash]] and [[Alternate World Dawn|Dawn]] up before heading to the [[Spear Pillar]], having been called to do so by his regular world counterpart. He and Chloe wore special outfits, copied from the designs made by [[Alternate World Team Rocket]], to prevent them and their Pokémon from being affected by the time reversal that was affecting the alternate [[Sinnoh]]. Alternate Goh later participated in the battle against Alternate World Team Rocket, until a power burst from {{OBP|Dialga|recurring}} destroyed his protective suit and caused him, along with every other person present, to turn younger and sent Team Rocket blasting off. Ash, Goh, {{an|Dawn}}, [[Chloe]], and their alternate counterparts prayed for {{p|Arceus}} to stop Dialga and {{OBP|Palkia|recurring}}'s fight, which it did, allowing the two [[Legendary Pokémon]] to undo the time reversal and return all the [[Devolution|devolved]] Pokémon back to normal. Alternate World Goh and regular Goh bid farewell as the latter was returned to his own world.
